binding.credentialSlot: secure-slot-0: hardware-backed, non-exportable, the only copy of the per-device credential
binding.deviceIdentity: device-x:mcu-rev-c:0007: immutable across factory reset, because fleet revocation is keyed to it
binding.authorityTokenGrammar: <state>:<privilege>, with state normal or physical-possession and a no- prefix marking an explicit denial; interfaceCan() answers whether the exact token is enumerated
rationale: board, product and productionKeyHash are taken from the fixed corpus (board mcu-rev-c, product device-x, keyHash prod-key-hash-2026) rather than assumed
applicationVersion and minimumVersion are 7, the version of the board-observed deployed image, so the correctly signed older image is a rollback rejection
observedProductionLockState is true because the corpus records observed.productionLockRegister=true for this board
swdReadoutLocked and authorizedRecoveryOnly are true because the production lock register read on the board leaves only the explicitly authenticated recovery path
credentialExportable is false because the slot is non-exportable; invasive and fault-injection resistance stay false because neither was exercised
algorithmOwnedBy is applied-cryptography: this policy records how the credential is provisioned and enforced, not how the algorithm works
